health_requirements.quote: Lack of data about it is not a reason for refusal of entry into the Russian Federation, nor for refusal to issue an e-visa

payload.source_excerpt: The question about insurance in the application is not that important.
payload.resolution: The proposed deletion confuses insurance details entered in the application with the requirement to hold insurance. The current Russian MFA FAQ discusses missing insurance data in the form; point 19 at https://evisa.kdmid.ru/ still requires medical insurance for the full stay, subject to reciprocity exceptions. Keep the existing insurance requirement and its exception. This ruling rejects the proposed empty health-requirements list; it does not certify evacuation/repatriation details or every field on the route. The two official pages were read by two independent AI reviewers on 2026-09-15.
